title: James Madison — Beginning, Struggle, Peak #Shorts
description:
The road from the beginning to the peak of James Madison ran through years nobody filmed. Madison was popularly acclaimed as the "Father of the Constitution" for his pivotal role in drafting and promoting the Constitution of the United States and the Bill of Rights. In 1774, strongly opposed to British taxation, Madison joined with the Patriots.

The rise of James Madison was not an accident — in retrospect the pattern is plain. That amendment, which guaranteed freedom of religion and disestablished the Church of England, was passed in 1786. Madison also became a land speculator, purchasing land along the Mohawk River in partnership with another Jefferson protégé, James Monroe.

scenes.narration: The road from the beginning to the peak of James Madison ran through years nobody filmed. Madison was
popularly acclaimed as the "Father of the Constitution" for his pivotal role in drafting and promoting the Constitution
of the United States and the Bill of Rights. In 1774, strongly opposed to British taxation, Madison joined

a member of both the Virginia House of Delegates and the Continental Congress during and after the American
Revolutionary War. Dissatisfied with the weak national government established by the Articles of Confederation, he helped organize the
